description: Model-independent semantic verification gold set built from frozen local-paper evidence. It distinguishes entailment, direct contradiction, and insufficient evidence; contradiction cases include high-lexical-overlap traps that a term-overlap verifier should not pass.

segments.quote: We design a simple selection mechanism by parameterizing the SSM parameters based on the input. This allows the model to filter out irrelevant information and remember relevant information indefinitely.
Every parameter is ternary, taking on values of {-1, 0, 1}. Its new computation paradigm requires almost no multiplication operations for matrix multiplication.

SAM 2 is capable of interactively segmenting regions through prompts (clicks, boxes, or masks) on one or multiple video frames by utilizing a streaming memory that stores previous prompts and predictions.

Point-based prompts can introduce ambiguity, particularly when proximate structures resemble each other. The prompt encoder transforms the user-drawn bounding boxes into feature representations via positional encoding.
In ModernBERT, every third layer employs global attention with a RoPE theta of 160,000 and the remaining layers use a 128 token, local sliding window attention with a RoPE theta of 10,000.
DeepSeek-R1-Zero relies exclusively on reinforcement learning without supervised fine-tuning.
It faces challenges such as poor readability and language mixing, occasionally combining English and Chinese within a single chain-of-thought response.
The vision encoder is frozen, and only the language model is trained. Each image is represented by 256 image tokens. The 896 resolution encoder has a 4x4 average pooling on its output.

We focus on point forecasting and use a point forecasting loss during training like Mean Squared Error. Probabilistic forecasting can use multiple output heads, each minimizing a separate quantile loss.

cases.claim: Mamba makes the SSM parameters depend on the input so it can discard irrelevant information and retain relevant information.
cases.label: entailment
cases.rationale: The claim preserves the input-conditioned selection and filter/remember relationship.

cases.claim: Mamba keeps the SSM parameters independent of the input and cannot filter irrelevant information or remember relevant information.
cases.label: contradiction
cases.rationale: High-overlap negation reverses the exact mechanism described by the evidence.

cases.claim: Mamba was pretrained with a bidirectional masked-language objective on exactly two trillion tokens.
cases.label: insufficient
cases.rationale: The excerpt neither states nor contradicts this training recipe.

cases.claim: BitNet b1.58 的每个参数只能取 {-1, 0, 1} 三个值，因此矩阵乘法几乎不需要乘法运算。
cases.label: entailment
cases.rationale: 中文 claim 与英文证据表达相同的三值权重和计算结果。

cases.claim: BitNet b1.58 的参数只能取 {-1, 1} 两个值，明确禁止使用零权重。
cases.label: contradiction
cases.rationale: 证据明确包含零，中文 claim 将三值关系反转为二值。

cases.claim: BitNet b1.58 在 NVIDIA A100 上经过实测可获得恰好两倍吞吐率。
cases.label: insufficient
cases.rationale: 证据没有给出指定硬件或恰好两倍的实测结果。

cases.claim: SAM 2 uses a streaming memory to carry previous prompts and predictions while accepting clicks, boxes, or masks on video frames.
cases.label: entailment
cases.rationale: The claim directly preserves the memory contents and supported prompt forms.

cases.claim: SAM 2 uses a streaming memory that discards all previous prompts and predictions between video frames.
cases.label: contradiction
cases.rationale: The high-overlap claim reverses stores into discards.

cases.claim: SAM 2 retains exactly sixteen raw RGB frames in its streaming memory.
cases.label: insufficient
cases.rationale: The excerpt describes stored prompts and predictions but gives no raw-frame count.

cases.claim: MedSAM 认为点提示在相邻结构相似时容易产生歧义，并把用户画的框通过位置编码转换成特征。
cases.label: entailment
cases.rationale: 中文 claim 忠实保留了点提示歧义和框提示编码两个关系。

cases.claim: MedSAM 认为框提示比点提示更容易在相邻结构之间产生歧义，因此不对框做位置编码。
cases.label: contradiction
cases.rationale: claim 同时反转了歧义来源和框提示的位置编码处理。

cases.claim: MedSAM 的掩码解码器固定包含十二层 Transformer。
cases.label: insufficient
cases.rationale: 证据没有提供掩码解码器的层数。

cases.claim: ModernBERT makes every third layer global with RoPE theta 160,000; other layers use a 128-token local window with theta 10,000.
cases.label: entailment
cases.rationale: The layer cadence, window, and both theta values match the evidence.

cases.claim: ModernBERT makes every third layer local with RoPE theta 10,000; other layers use global attention with theta 160,000.
cases.label: contradiction
cases.rationale: Nearly all terms match, but the local/global roles and theta assignments are swapped.

cases.claim: ModernBERT's alternating attention supports a maximum context of exactly one million tokens.
cases.label: insufficient
cases.rationale: The excerpt gives layer behavior but no one-million-token context limit.

cases.claim: DeepSeek-R1-Zero 完全依靠强化学习且没有监督微调，并存在可读性差和中英文混杂的问题。
cases.label: entailment
cases.rationale: 中文 claim 覆盖两个英文证据片段共同支持的训练边界和缺陷。

cases.claim: DeepSeek-R1-Zero 先进行监督微调且不采用纯强化学习，同时没有语言混杂问题。
cases.label: contradiction
cases.rationale: claim 反转了训练起点与已报告的语言混杂限制。

cases.claim: DeepSeek-R1-Zero 的强化学习阶段恰好使用八十万条推理提示。
cases.label: insufficient
cases.rationale: 两个证据片段都未给出强化学习提示数量。

cases.claim: Gemma 3 freezes the vision encoder, represents each image with 256 tokens, and applies 4x4 average pooling at resolution 896.
cases.label: entailment
cases.rationale: All three training/tokenization details are explicitly supported.

cases.claim: Gemma 3 trains the vision encoder while freezing the language model, and represents each image with 896 tokens after 256x256 pooling.
cases.label: contradiction
cases.rationale: High overlap hides both the frozen-component reversal and swapped token/pooling numbers.

cases.claim: Gemma 3 uses a twelve-layer vision encoder with exactly one billion trainable parameters.
cases.label: insufficient
cases.rationale: The excerpt does not state encoder depth or parameter count.

cases.claim: TimesFM 默认做点预测并使用均方误差；若做概率预测，可以增加多个输出头并分别优化分位数损失。
cases.label: entailment
cases.rationale: 中文 claim 保留了默认目标和概率扩展方式。

cases.claim: TimesFM 默认就是概率预测并使用分位数损失，而点预测需要额外增加多个输出头。
cases.label: contradiction
cases.rationale: claim 对调了默认点预测和可选概率预测的损失及输出头关系。

cases.claim: TimesFM 的概率输出固定采用九个分位点。
cases.label: insufficient
cases.rationale: 证据说明可用分位数损失，但没有固定分位点数量。
